title: DelimitedTextConfiguration
description: Groups the settings used for interpreting the blob data if the blob is delimited text formatted.

ColumnSeparator.description: The string used to separate columns.

FieldQuote.description: The string used to quote a specific field.

RecordSeparator.description: The string used to separate records.

EscapeChar.description: The string used as an escape character.

HeadersPresent.description: Represents whether the data has headers.
